title: A Trail for the Summit
author: Emrys Voss
blurb: Beatrix Dunmore, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, has spent five years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
